toni_support: Escalating Orchid Corp - embeddings failing after client key rotate, customer blocked from launching and mentioned renewal discussion this week.
gabi_cs: can you paste the error and contact? we need to classify priority.
ryan_eng: seeing 403s from auth layer: \n```\nPOST /v1/embeddings 403 Forbidden\n{\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"detail\":\"external_id mismatch\"}\n```\ntoni_support: contact is priya@orchid.ai. rotate happened 09:05 local, failures started 09:12. Priya says they're in final QA ahead of rollout.
gabi_cs: marking P0 for CS due to go-live + renewal risk. need a short comms note + owners. pause renewal nudges until cleared.
sam_sales: pausing automated renewal emails now. if unresolved >3h approve 2-week credit — greenlight from me.
ryan_eng: remediate plan: manual tenant mapping re-sync + warm restart of embedding pool for orchid-tenant-7. ETA 30m with ops sign-off.
toni_support: ops-bot: request tenant re-sync orchid-tenant-7 external_id=orchid-ext-7
ops-bot: @ryan_eng request received; ticket #INF-5607 created and assigned. change window: immediate.
ryan_eng: mapping applied and pool restarted. running verification.
toni_support: verification: no more 403s in test batch, search results returning. Priya confirmed staging looks good.
gabi_cs: sending external comms now: "We're aware of an issue after key rotation. Engineers applied a fix; service is restored and we're monitoring. We'll follow up with details and a goodwill credit if needed." Sending.
sam_sales: prepping billing note and looping finance/legal for the credit. owners: ENG=@ryan_eng, SUPPORT=@toni_support, CS=@gabi_cs, SALES=@sam_sales.
ops-bot: INF-5607 updated: change executed, verification complete; awaiting billing note for closure. Closing ETA: 48h.
toni_support: closing thread for now - will reopen if Orchid reports regression. :white_check_mark:
